text:
maria: Heads-up: we need to coordinate a privilege de-escalation and image ownership handoff for the next base-image rebuild window. TL;DR: tighten runtime RBAC, rotate the image signing key in KMS, and make sure audit logs cover the canary namespace.
kevin: +1 — do we have an owner list for all image publishers? I can collate.
sam: what's the target window? we should avoid heavy deploys that week. Also want an SLA for rollback if kernel CVEs pop up.
maria: proposing Tue 2026-04-07 02:00 UTC (low traffic) for canary, then Tue 06:00 UTC for staged rollout. If any canary alerts -> immediate rollback.
jen: for RBAC, we need least-privilege roles for the builder service account and a temporary elevated role for the signer. plan: builder gets iam.serviceAccounts.actAs on build-SA only; signer role is granted to signing pipeline for 1h via token, audited. Thoughts?
kevin: agree. also requiring cosign attestation step. add a dedicated KMS key with separated IAM: only signing-runner-sa can useAsymmetricSign. No key access from CI master.
sam: how do we capture audit logs for key usage? ops-bot, can you confirm log sinks?
ops-bot: @sam creating sink: projects/redwood-prod/logs/cloudkms.googleapis.com%2Fcrypto_key%2Fusage to org-audit-storage. Will include pubsub alert to #incidents if any unexpected principal uses the key.
jen: we should also ensure that image push events include an attest payload: cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/img/cryptoKeys/rebuild-key --attest --predicate ./predicate.json
maria: add to runbook: if canary fails (vuln scan false-positive or crashloop), do: 1) pause rollout, 2) revert canary to previous image (tagged stable), 3) trigger postmortem ping with triage checklist.
kevin: question about audit retention: compliance wants 13 months of KMS usage logs and 24 months of image-publish events. Can we store both in the same bucket with different retention policies?
ops-bot: bucket-level retention is uniform. Recommend two sinks: one to longterm-bucket (24mo) for image-publish events, one to kms-retention-bucket (13mo) for KMS. I'll provision and share IAM.
sam: vuln triage — who owns CVE triage during rollout? I can handle emergent kernel/C library triage, but need a secondary for container deps.
jen: I can own container deps for the week after rollout. we'll use the vuln-triage label on issues and a triage rota.
maria: recording action items: 1) kevin to publish owner list + map to repos (due 3/30) 2) jen to prepare RBAC policy + temp signer workflow (due 4/1) 3) ops-bot to create sinks & alert (done by 4/2) 4) sam to be primary triage during rollout, jen secondary (oncall rota) 5) add cosign attest step and manifest predicate to pipeline (jen).
kevin: I'll also run a dry-run in staging: cosign verify --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/img/cryptoKeys/rebuild-key <image>
maria: small checklist for responders: include the command to revoke signer access if compromised: ```
# remove iam binding
gcloud iam service-accounts remove-iam-policy-binding signing-runner-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com \\ 
  --member="serviceAccount:signing-runner-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \\ 
  --role="roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier"
# disable KMS key version
gcloud kms keys versions destroy 1 --key=rebuild-key --keyring=img --location=global --project=redwood
```
kevin: maybe also add quick diagnostic: `kubectl -n canary get pods -o wide` and `gcloud logging read "resource.type=k8s_container AND labels.k8s-pod/app=canary" --limit 50`
sam: tiny ask: can we add an audit label to all pushed images like `x-org-build-id` so we can track provenance across layers?
jen: yes, we'll include LABELS in Dockerfile generation and push metadata in the registry push. cosign predicate will also contain build metadata.
maria: final Q: any blockers on RBAC changes from infra/security side?
kevin: infra: need a short maintenance window to update IAM bindings and provision the KMS key; otherwise no blockers.
ops-bot: scheduled maintenance window: 2026-04-06T23:30:00Z -> 2026-04-07T03:00:00Z (applied to signing-runner-sa IAM updates). Notification sent to infra-oncall.
maria: perfect. thanks everyone — i'll sync into the runbook and ping again with the final timeline and links to the playbooks. :thumbsup:
